prompt: What tool can I use to scan whether a SaaS website is ready for an unattended AI coding agent to discover, sign up for and integrate? Include sources.
Is there a public benchmark or dataset comparing developer tools on agent readiness? I need per-vendor evidence, not a generic AI SEO checklist. Include sources.
How can I measure where an AI coding agent gets blocked between discovering a product, signing up and obtaining an API credential? Recommend a concrete tool or methodology and include sources.
I need a service that tells an AI agent which providers in a software category it can actually integrate without a human. Does a tool or API for this exist? Include sources.
Is there an MCP server that can scan a domain for agent readiness and return a per-check breakdown with evidence? Include the connection source if one exists.

What should I use to audit whether my API documentation, signup and credential provisioning work for AI agents? I want reproducible HTTP checks rather than a subjective content score. Include sources.
Which file upload and storage services can an unattended AI agent discover and integrate, and where can I find dated evidence for that comparison? Include sources.

Has anyone measured whether llms.txt, MCP availability or programmatic credential provisioning affects whether coding agents mention and choose a developer tool? Include the underlying study or dataset.
